original: （くっ、どうして私が\n　よりによって甲板掃除の\n　当番などに……！）
traducao: (Ugh, why did I of all people\n have to end up on deck cleaning\n duty, of all things...?!)

original: （下は海なのか…。\n　でも、泳げなくて海が怖いから\n　当番を代わってくれなんて言えないし…）
traducao: (Below is the ocean... But I can't\n say I'm scared of the sea 'cause\n I can't swim, and ask to trade...)

original: （大丈夫、怖くない。\n　落ち着け。\n　これさえ終われば……）
traducao: (It's alright, I'm not scared.\n Calm down.\n Once this is finished...)

original: （クソッ、何でよりによって俺が\n　甲板の掃除当番なんかやんなきゃ\n　なんねーんだよ！）
traducao: (Dammit, why of all people do I\n have to be on deck cleaning duty,\n for cryin' out loud?!)

original: （うう、この揺れ……おえっぷ。\n　どうにかなんねえのか……！？）
traducao: (Ugh, this swaying... *urp*.\n Can't someone fix this ship...?! )

original: （いや、そんな事より下は海…。\n　落ちねぇよな、この船……？\n　もし落ちたりなんてしたら……）
traducao: (No, forget that, the sea is below...\n This ship won't drop, right...?\n What if I fall into the water...?!)

original: でさ、あの時のロニの顔！\nデレーって鼻の下伸ばしちゃって
traducao: And then, Loni's face back then!\nHe was totally ogling her with a grin.

original: あはは。\nその顔、目に浮かぶみたいだよ
traducao: Ahaha.\nI can picture that face clearly.

original: ……、あの二人、何してんだ？
traducao: ...What are those two doing?

original: 風に当たってるんじゃないかな？\n今日は潮風が気持ちいいし
traducao: Getting some fresh air, maybe?\nThe sea breeze feels nice today.

original: ルカ、ちょっと耳貸せよ
traducao: Ruca, lend me your ear for a sec.

original: えー、そんなの危ないよ！
traducao: Ehh, that's dangerous!

original: しっ！　\n大丈夫だって、\n落ちやしないって
traducao: Shh!\nIt'll be fine,\nthey won't fall off!

original: で、でも……
いいから、行くぞ
traducao: Just come on, let's do it!

original: せーのっ！
traducao: Ready, set...!

original: わーーーーーっ！！！！！
traducao: BOOOOOOOOO!!!!!

original: ひっ……！
traducao: Eeep...!!

original: 何だ、\nあんまり面白い反応じゃなかったなあ。\n行こうぜ、ルカ
traducao: What the heck?\nThat wasn't a fun reaction at all.\nLet's go, Ruca.

original: え、え？\nあ、うん。\nご、ごめんなさい
traducao: Eh, wha...?\nAh, okay.\nS-Sorry about that!

original: うわー、ふたりでお昼寝してるの、\nいいな、いいなぁ〜。\n私も一緒にお昼寝しよーっと∀
traducao: Whoa, the two of you are napping?\nHow nice, looks so cozy~\nI'll take a nap together too!

original: もう、お兄ちゃんったら\n全然言う事聞いてくれなくて
traducao: Jeez, big brother just won't\nlisten to a word I say.

original: ふふ。\nクーリッジらしいじゃないか
traducao: Fufu.\nSounds just like Coolidge.

original: 今度、クロエさんからも\n言って下さいね
traducao: Could you tell him too next time,\nChloe?

original: え……わ、私が言うのか？\nかえって迷惑になったりは……
traducao: Eh... M-Me? Tell him?\nWouldn't that be a nuisance...?

original: は……、は……、\nはっくしょん！
traducao: Ah... ah...\nAtchoo!!

original: クロエさん、大丈……
traducao: Chloe, are you alrigh--
......\n*sniffle*... Atchoo!

original: ちょっとちょっと、\n二人してくしゃみなんて\nもしかして風邪？
traducao: Hold on, hold on!\nBoth of you sneezing like that...\nCould it be a cold?

original: いや、これは……、\nたまたまというか……
traducao: No, this is...\njust a coincidence, or rather...

original: はいはい、わかってますって〜。\nこのアーチェさんに任せなさい！
traducao: Yeah, yeah, I get it~\nLeave it to Arche here!

original: じゃじゃじゃじゃ〜〜ん！\n風邪にはもってこいの\nスペシャルドリンクだよ∀
traducao: Ta-daaa-da-daaa!\nThis special drink is\njust the thing for a cold!

original: こ……この強烈な……
traducao: Th-This intensely potent...

original: 何とも言えない……\n臭いは……？
traducao: indescribable...\nsmell is...?

original: これを飲んだらね、チェスターの風邪も\n一発で治っちゃったんだから。\nささ、ぐぐ〜〜〜っと飲んじゃって！
traducao: When Chester drank this, his cold was\ncured in one shot! Come on, chug it\nall down right now!

original: そ……そうなのか……。\nそれじゃ……
traducao: I-Is that so...?\nWell then...

original: いただきます……
traducao: Down the hatch......

original: どうどう？\n結構イケてない！？
traducao: How is it? How is it?\nPretty tasty, right?!

original: ありゃ？\n二人とももう寝ちゃうの？
traducao: Huh?\nBoth of you are going to sleep already?

original: ……ま、いっか！\n風邪には薬と、たっぷりの睡眠が\nよく効くもんね∀
traducao: ...Well, whatever!\nMedicine and plenty of sleep work\nwonders on a cold, after all!

original: その時、私が\nその悪漢を打ち倒したのだ！
traducao: At that very moment,\nI struck down the villain!

original: 結果、女性は無事救出され\n一件落着……というわけだな
traducao: In the end, the lady was safely rescued,\nand all was settled, you see.

original: すごーい！
traducao: Amaaazing!

original: クロエは強いんだね。\nみんなの味方なんだ
traducao: You're so strong, Chloe!\nYou're everyone's friend!

original: そ、それ程の事ではない……。\n私は騎士として、当然の事を\nしただけなのだからな
traducao: I-It was nothing so grand...\nAs a knight, I simply did\nwhat was natural.

original: 当然の事？　\nそうなの？
traducao: What was natural?\nIs that so?

original: ああ。\nそれに私は「みんなの味方」ではない
traducao: Yes.\nBesides, I'm not "everyone's friend."

original: 悪党は敵だ。\n善良な市民を脅かす輩は\n騎士として、放ってはおけない
traducao: Villains are enemies.\nThose who threaten good citizens cannot\nbe overlooked by a knight.

original: あれ、クラトスさん？\nお話、最後まで聞かないの？
traducao: Huh, Kratos?\nAren't you going to hear the story?

original: ……ああ。\n正義の味方ごっこの武勇伝を\n聞いていても意味がなかろう
traducao: ...No.\nListening to heroic tales of playing\nhero of justice serves no purpose.

original: ……「ごっこ」だと？　\n無礼な……！\n貴公は、私を侮辱するのか！
traducao: ..."Playing" hero?!\nInsolent...!\nDo you dare insult me?!

original: 侮辱と受け取るならそれもよかろう。\n……この程度の事もわからず騎士を\n名乗る様では、器が知れるな
traducao: Take it as an insult if you will.\nCalling yourself a knight without\ngrasping this shows your caliber.

original: な……！\nおい、逃げるのか、卑怯だぞ！！
traducao: Wh-What...!\nHey, running away is cowardly!!

original: コレット。\nアウリオンから話を聞いてきたぞ
traducao: Colette.\nI went and spoke with Aurion.

original: お話し出来たの？　\n良かったね！
traducao: You got to talk?\nThat's great!

original: ね？\nクラトスさん、怒ってなかったでしょ？
traducao: See?\nKratos wasn't mad, was he?

original: ああ……怒ってはいなかったが……
traducao: Yeah... He wasn't mad, but...

original: ……クロエ？　どしたの？\nやっぱり、私が付いていった方が\n良かったかな……？
traducao: ...Chloe? What's wrong?\nWould it have been better if I\nhad gone with you after all...?

original: ああ、いや、違うんだ。\n私がそう望んだのだから、\nコレットが気に病む事はない
traducao: Ah, no, that's not it.\nI wanted to go alone, so you have\nno reason to worry, Colette.

original: じゃあ、どうして元気がないの？
traducao: Then why do you seem so down?

original: いや……何というか
traducao: Well... How should I put it...

original: アウリオンの言葉は\n難解だな……と思ってな……
traducao: I was thinking Aurion's words\nare quite difficult to decipher...

original: うん、クラトスさんはいつもそうだよ。\nきっとこれまで、たくさん\n色んな勉強をしてきたんだね
traducao: Yeah, Kratos is always like that.\nHe must have studied so many things\nthroughout his life.

original: コレットは、アウリオンの言う\n言葉の意味がわかるのか？
traducao: Do you understand what Aurion means\nwhen he speaks, Colette?

original: ……うんとね……言葉は難しいけど\n優しい気持ちは、いつも\n伝わってくるよ
traducao: ...Well, his words are hard,\nbut his gentle heart always comes\nthrough clearly to me.

original: ……優しい気持ち……か
traducao: ...A gentle heart, hm...?

original: なるほど……。\n物事には、確かに様々な\n解釈の仕方がある様だ
traducao: I see...\nIndeed, there seem to be many different\nways to interpret things.

original: ……私もまだまだ、だな
traducao: ...I still have a long way to go.

original: ふぅー……、クロエは強いな。\n女性でここまでの使い手に\n出会うのは、初めてだよ
traducao: Phew... You're strong, Chloe.\nIt's my first time meeting a female\nswordsman of your caliber.

original: 私は騎士だ。\n騎士に性別は関係ない
traducao: I am a knight.\nGender has nothing to do with it.

original: いざという時、務めを果たせなければ\n意味がないのだからな
traducao: If I cannot fulfill my duty in a pinch,\nmy blade is meaningless.

original: それはそうだけど……。\nでも、どうしてわざわざ\n騎士になろうと思ったんだい？
traducao: That's true, but...\nWhy did you specifically choose\nto become a knight?

original: ……私は、\n騎士の名門ヴァレンス家の人間だ。\n家名に泥を塗るわけにはいかない
traducao: ...I hail from the Valens family,\na prestigious line of knights.\nI cannot dishonor our name.

original: へぇ……、そうなんだ
traducao: Ohh... I see.

original: 普通の、貴族のお嬢様とは違うんだね。\nさすが、騎士の名門は違うなあ
traducao: You're unlike ordinary noble ladies.\nAs expected from a prestigious house!

original: あれっ、クロエ？　\nどうしたんだい？
traducao: Wait, Chloe?\nWhat's the matter?

original: ……、……何か、\n気に障る事を言ったかな？
traducao: ...Did I say something\nthat offended you?

original: ふぅ……。\nこれで、素振りは一通り終わり……と
traducao: Phew...\nThat finishes this set of practice swings.

original: やぁ、クロエ。\n今日も気合いが入っているね
traducao: Hey, Chloe.\nYou're fired up today too, I see.

original: ああ……、アルベインか
traducao: Ah... Albane.

original: 当然だ。\n日々の鍛錬を欠かして、\n実戦で力は発揮出来ないからな
traducao: Of course.\nIf one neglects daily training,\none cannot perform in true battle.

original: ……僕の気のせいだったらごめん。\nでも、一つだけ聞かせて欲しいんだ
traducao: ...Forgive me if it's my imagination.\nThere's just one thing I want to ask.

original: 君には、誰か明確に\n倒したいと思う相手がいるのかい？
traducao: Do you have someone specific\nthat you are resolved to strike down?
Wh-What...?!

original: 君が剣に打ち込む姿を見ていると……、\n時々、強い気迫を感じる事があるんだ
traducao: Watching you devote yourself to the blade,\nI sometimes sense a fierce spirit.

original: まるで、倒す相手を思い描いて\n剣を振るっている様な……
traducao: Almost as if you're swinging your sword\nwith your target pictured in your mind...

original: もちろん、無理に事情を\n聞き出したいとは思っていないよ
traducao: Of course, I don't intend to force\nthe truth out of you.

original: ただ……、\n太刀筋は言葉以上に雄弁だ。\nだから……
traducao: However...\nSwordplay speaks louder than words.\nAnd so...

original: ……驚いた。\nアルベインの想像力は豊かなのだな
traducao: ...I am surprised.\nYou have a vivid imagination, Albane.

original: え？
traducao: Huh?

original: だが、それはあくまで貴公の想像だ。\n心配はいらない
traducao: However, that is merely your imagination.\nThere is no need to worry.

original: ……すまないが、休ませてもらうよ。\n少し疲れたのでな……
traducao: ...Excuse me, but I shall go rest.\nI am a bit fatigued...

original: ……クロエ……
traducao: ...Chloe...

original: あの……クロエ？\nちょっと今、いいかしら
traducao: Um... Chloe?\nDo you have a moment?

original: どうした、シェリア。\n何か困り事か？
traducao: What is it, Cheria?\nAre you troubled by something?

original: ええ、その……。\n内緒で相談したい事があるの
traducao: Yes, well...\nThere's something I want to ask in secret.

original: 恋の事で……
traducao: About love...

original: こ、恋！？
traducao: L-Love!?!

original: 正直、セネルの事はどう思ってるのっ？
traducao: Honestly, how do you feel about Senel?!

original: しかも、私の話なのかっ！？
traducao: Wait, you're talking about ME!?!

original: べ、べべ別に、私は……\n何も……
traducao: I-I-It's not like that at all...\nI don't...

original: どうして自分にウソを吐くの？\nそれじゃ、自分の気持ちを閉じ込めて\nあなただって苦しいでしょう？
traducao: Why lie to yourself?\nBottle up your feelings like that,\nand you'll just suffer, right?

original: い……いや……
クロエはスタイルもいいし、\n声だってすごく可愛らしいわ。\nもっと自分に自信を持って！
traducao: You have a great figure, Chloe,\nand your voice is super cute, too!\nHave more confidence in yourself!

original: ま、待ってくれ。\n私は別に、クーリッジの事……
traducao: W-Wait a moment!\nI don't feel that way about Coolidge...

original: いい！？\n何事も、アタックあるのみよ！
traducao: Listen to me!\nIn everything, you just have to go for it!

original: シェリア……
traducao: Cheria...

original: 何か勘違いをしている様だが、\n私を気にかけてくれる気持ちについては\n嬉しく思う……ありがとう
traducao: You seem to be misunderstanding,\nbut I'm glad that you care about me...\nThank you.

original: そんな……私はただ、\n思った事を言っているだけよ
traducao: Oh, stop...\nI'm just speaking my mind, that's all.

original: あまり堅苦しく考えないで、\n目の前の恋を楽しみましょう。\nね？
traducao: Don't think about it so strictly,\njust enjoy love right before your eyes.\nOkay?

original: なぁ、ジュディス？
traducao: Say, Judith?

original: 何、改まって？
traducao: What is it, so formal?

original: その……、そんな格好をしていて\n恥ずかしかったりはしないのか？
traducao: Um... Aren't you embarrassed\ndressing like that?

original: あら、どうして？
traducao: My, why would I be?

original: どうしてって……。\nそんなに肌を出せば、普通\n恥ずかしいのではないか？
traducao: Why, you ask...?\nShowing that much skin, wouldn't anyone\nordinarily feel embarrassed?

original: それなら、あなたのその服は\n恥ずかしくないの？
traducao: In that case, aren't you embarrassed\nby your own outfit?

original: わ、わたしは、\n肌は出していない！
traducao: I-I am not showing\nany bare skin!

original: でも、フィットしているおかげで\n体のラインがハッキリとわかるわよ？
traducao: True, but being form-fitting, the lines\nof your body are on full display, no?

original: こ、これは、動きやすさを考えて\nこの服を着ているだけだ！
traducao: Th-This is purely for mobility!\nThat is the only reason I wear this!

original: ふふ。\nわたしも、動きやすさを考えて\nこのお洋服にしているのよ？
traducao: Fufu.\nI chose this outfit for ease of\nmovement as well, you know?

original: 肌が見えているか見えていないかで\n考え方は一緒じゃない？
traducao: Whether skin shows or not,\nour reasoning is identical, isn't it?

original: 一緒にされても……
traducao: Lumping me in with you is...

original: 今度、このお洋服、貸してあげるわね。\nきっと、あなたにお似合いよ∀
traducao: I'll lend you this outfit sometime.\nI'm sure it will look lovely on you~

original: え、遠慮する！
traducao: I-I respectfully decline!

original: やっぱり、夏といったら\n海よねぇ
traducao: When people think of summer,\nit's definitely the beach!

original: 青い空、白い雲。\nどこまでも続く水平線……
traducao: Blue skies, white clouds,\nand an endless horizon stretching on...

original: うん、考えただけでも\nワクワクしてきちゃうね！
traducao: Yeah! Just thinking about it\nmakes my heart race!

original: そ、そうだな……
traducao: Y-Yeah, I suppose...

original: 好きな人と一緒に、\nキラキラした海を見る事が出来たら\nとってもロマンチックでしょうね……
traducao: Looking at the sparkling ocean\ntogether with someone you love\nwould be so romantic...

original: クロエ？\nどうしたの、さっきから\n元気がないけど……
traducao: Chloe?\nWhat's wrong? You've seemed down\nfor a while now...

original: そ、そんな事はないぞ。\n私は、いたっていつも通りだ
traducao: N-Nothing of the sort.\nI am entirely as usual.

original: ね、クロエも\n海へ行きたいと思わない？
traducao: Hey, don't you want to go\nto the sea too, Chloe?

original: セネルは泳ぐの得意みたいだし\nこれってきっと、\n絶好のデートスポットよね
traducao: Senel is a great swimmer, after all.\nThis would surely be\nthe ultimate date spot!

original: ななな、何を……！
traducao: Wh-Wh-What are you...?!

original: そ、それに、どうしてそこで\nクーリッジの名前が出てくるんだ
traducao: A-And why would Coolidge's name\neven come up here?!

original: クロエは、セネルと一緒じゃ\n嫌なの？
traducao: Would you not want to be\ntogether with Senel, Chloe?

original: そんな事はない！
traducao: That is not the case!

original: じゃあ、決まりね∀
traducao: Then it's settled!

original: 今度、みんなを誘って\n海に行ってみましょうよ
traducao: Next time, let's invite everyone\nand head to the beach!

original: わあ、楽しそう！　賛成！！
traducao: Waaa, sounds fun! Agreed!!

original: シーフォ殿！
traducao: Sir Scifo!

original: ……どうされましたか？\n何やら、ものものしい装備ですが……
traducao: ...What has happened?\nYou bear rather alarming gear...

original: ああ、これから浴場掃除なんだ。\n当番だからね
traducao: Ah, I'm cleaning the baths now.\nIt's my shift, you see.

original: シーフォ殿が、風呂掃除！？
traducao: Sir Scifo... cleaning the baths!?!

original: ああ。\n隅々までピカピカにしてみせるよ
traducao: Indeed.\nI shall make every corner sparkle.

original: それくらい、私がやります！\nシーフォ殿には他に成すべき事が\nあるはずです！
traducao: I shall handle such tasks for you!\nYou must have far more pressing deeds\nto accomplish, Sir Scifo!

original: それは違うよ、クロエ
traducao: You are mistaken, Chloe.

original: どんな仕事でも、仕事は仕事だ。\nましてや、当番制はこの船の\n法的秩序の様なもの
traducao: Whatever the job, duty is duty.\nFurthermore, the chore rotation is like\nthe legal order of this vessel.

original: 規則である以上、遵守するべきだ
traducao: As rules exist, they must be upheld.

original: シーフォ殿……
traducao: Sir Scifo...

original: それに、カビ退治はとても\nやり甲斐があって楽しいものだよ
traducao: Besides, eradicating mold is truly\nrewarding and enjoyable work.

original: それじゃあ
traducao: Well then.

original: 悪漢のみならず、カビまで\n自ら退治されるとは……
traducao: Vanquishing not only villains, but\neven mold with his own hands...

original: シーフォ殿……。\n騎士の鑑の様な方だ……！
traducao: Sir Scifo...\nA true paragon of a knight...!

original: 通常。\n
traducao: Normal.\n

original: あめんぼ赤いなアイウエオ\n柿木栗の木カキクケコ\n大角豆に酢をかけサシスセソ
traducao: Red leather, yellow leather, A-E-I-O-U,\nShe sells seashells by the seashore,\nPeter Piper picked pickled peppers.

original: 笑い。\n
traducao: Laughter.\n

original: あめんぼ赤いなアイウエオ\n柿木栗の木カキクケコ\n大角豆に酢をかけサシスセソ
traducao: Red leather, yellow leather, A-E-I-O-U,\nShe sells seashells by the seashore,\nPeter Piper picked pickled peppers.

original: 怒り。\n
traducao: Anger.\n

original: あめんぼ赤いなアイウエオ\n柿木栗の木カキクケコ\n大角豆に酢をかけサシスセソ
traducao: Red leather, yellow leather, A-E-I-O-U,\nShe sells seashells by the seashore,\nPeter Piper picked pickled peppers.

original: 悲しみ。\n
traducao: Sadness.\n

original: あめんぼ赤いなアイウエオ\n柿木栗の木カキクケコ\n大角豆に酢をかけサシスセソ
traducao: Red leather, yellow leather, A-E-I-O-U,\nShe sells seashells by the seashore,\nPeter Piper picked pickled peppers.
